import AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Measure.GaussianConvolutionRegularity
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
noncomputable section
abbrev E0 := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 0)
#synth CompleteSpace E0
#synth CompleteSpace (E0 →L[ℝ] ℝ)
#synth CompleteSpace (E0 →L[ℝ] (E0 →L[ℝ] ℝ))
example : Module.finrank ℝ E0 = 0 := by simp [E0]
example {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (μ : Measure E0) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] :
    let C := ((Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi*η))⁻¹)^Module.finrank ℝ E0
    let Z := fun y : E0 => ∫ x, Real.exp (-‖y-x‖^2/(2*η)) ∂μ
    (μ.prod (stdGaussian E0)).map (fun p => p.1+Real.sqrt η • p.2) =
      (volume : Measure E0).withDensity (fun y => ENNReal.ofReal (C*Z y)) ∧
    (∀ y, 0 < C*Z y) ∧ ContDiff ℝ 2 Z ∧
      ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun y => -Real.log (C*Z y)) :=
  AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Measure.GaussianConvolutionRegularity.gaussian_convolution_potential_c2 μ hη
